response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT attendee_count, 1.0 * attendee_count / SUM(attendee_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(c.attendee_count) AS average_attendees, AVG(c.share) AS average_share, AVG(c.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_average FROM city_shares AS c CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE c.share > a.share;
